caption: The drawing depicts a ceramic vessel with two ornate handles and a separate lid, both rendered in light gray with accents of pale yellow along the rim, lid, and other details. The main body of the vessel features a blue pastoral landscape scene, possibly a river or lake with trees and buildings, centrally placed as a decoration. The lid, positioned in the foreground leaning against the vessel, is decorated with yellow scrollwork and lines. The vessel has an overall rounded body and the handles curve outward and upward, ending in spiral forms. Above the vessel, there is a lightly sketched box containing the text “BRIDGEWOOD AND SON.” Below the vessel, a scaled-down technical drawing displays the object from the front and indicates the height and width, labeled as 5 1/4" for both dimensions. The composition is laid out on cream-colored paper with light pencil outlines and faint traces of construction lines.
title: Sugar Bowl
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
